kiel-schlei-schwansen-coffee-loop.title: Kiel · Schwansen Villages and Schlei Coffee Loop
kiel-schlei-schwansen-coffee-loop.slogan: A 178 km loop out of Gettorf road
kiel-schlei-schwansen-coffee-loop.story: Small harbours, farm-road bends and one proper coffee reset. The best part sits around Gettorf road, Eckernförde bay, Schwansen villages, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 67 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Simplon Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: 149 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 104 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

grand-tour-of-switzerland.story: Out of Zürich and back again: 1643 km, roughly 26 h 30 in the saddle. On the way it passes Rhine Falls, St Gallen, Appenzell and Davos. The highest point is about 2,650 m. Fluela Pass and Furka Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
